1c6fd619-01.png.summary: Title page and executive summary of the combined deep hedging research report. Contains overview of experimental framework: 7 models tested across 10 seeds with 50K training samples under fair two-stage CVaR→Entropic protocol.

1c6fd619-02.png.summary: Main results table showing CVaR95 performance across all models. RSE achieves best CVaR95=3.109±0.010, LSTM baseline=3.215±0.018. RVSN (0.443) and SAC-CVaR (14.933) flagged as anomalous.

1c6fd619-03.png.summary: Statistical comparison table with paired t-tests, Holm-Bonferroni correction, and Cohen's d effect sizes. RSE vs LSTM: p<0.0001, d=-7.41 (very large effect).

1c6fd619-04.png.summary: Bootstrap confidence intervals (10,000 resamples) for all models. RSE CI=[3.104,3.115] non-overlapping with all other models.

1c6fd619-05.png.summary: Training time comparison and computational requirements. LSTM: 273s, Transformer: 7534s, W-DRO-T: 7119s, RSE: 924s, 3SCH: 295s per seed.

1c6fd619-06.png.summary: Stability analysis showing coefficient of variation (CV%) across models. RSE: 0.30% (best), LSTM: 0.55%, Transformer: 0.92%. All baseline models CV<1%.

1c6fd619-07.png.summary: Anomaly analysis for RVSN and SAC-CVaR. RVSN: CV=59.76%, positive mean P&L suggests biased hedges. SAC-CVaR: CVaR=14.93, RL agent not learning effective policy.

1c6fd619-08.png.summary: Real market validation setup: SPY (3 bps cost) and NIFTY (18 bps cost) with crisis scenario definitions (Normal, COVID, 2008).

1c6fd619-10.png.summary: NIFTY crisis testing and conclusions. 3SCH best normal (622.26), Transformer best COVID (1644.19), W-DRO-T best 2008 (2349.72). Market-specific model selection critical.

866cd18f-01.png.summary: Title page of Novel Deep Hedging Approaches report. Covers W-DRO-T, RVSN, SAC-CVaR, 3SCH, and RSE methodologies.

866cd18f-02.png.summary: W-DRO-T mathematical formulation: Wasserstein DRO objective, dual form, gradient penalty approximation. Equation: L_DRO = E[l(θ;X)] + ε·E[‖∇_X l‖₂].

866cd18f-03.png.summary: W-DRO-T training protocol: Phase 1 CVaR pretraining (50 epochs), Phase 2 DRO-annealed entropic (30 epochs, ε: 0→0.1), Phase 3 stress testing (10 epochs, ε=0.2).

866cd18f-04.png.summary: W-DRO-T implementation details: SDPA MATH backend requirement for create_graph=True, second-order gradient computation through attention layers.

866cd18f-05.png.summary: RVSN mathematical formulation: Rough Bergomi model, fractional Brownian motion, adaptive signature depth based on local Hurst parameter estimates.

866cd18f-06.png.summary: RVSN architecture: Hurst estimator network, lead-lag transform, adaptive signature compression, multi-depth gating.

866cd18f-07.png.summary: SAC-CVaR formulation: Constrained MDP, Lagrangian relaxation, distributional critic with 51 quantiles for CVaR estimation.

866cd18f-08.png.summary: SAC-CVaR architecture: Gaussian policy, twin Q-networks, quantile critic, Lagrange multiplier update rule.

866cd18f-09.png.summary: 3SCH mathematical formulation: Mixed loss L_mixed(α) = α·CVaR + (1-α)·ρ_λ with annealing schedule α: 0.8→0.2.

866cd18f-10.png.summary: 3SCH training protocol: Stage 1 CVaR (50 ep), Stage 2 mixed (20 ep), Stage 3 entropic+penalties (30 ep). No-trade band penalty formulation.

866cd18f-11.png.summary: RSE architecture diagram: Regime feature extractor (RV, trend, momentum, jump), regime classifier (MLP), gating network (affinity matrix), base model ensemble.

866cd18f-12.png.summary: RSE regime features: Realized volatility at windows {5,10,20}, SMA crossover trend, momentum, Barndorff-Nielsen jump indicator.

866cd18f-13.png.summary: RSE training: Pre-train base models (30 ep each, CVaR), freeze, train gating (CVaR 20 ep + entropic 30 ep).

866cd18f-14.png.summary: Experimental setup: 80K Heston paths, 50K/10K/20K split, N=30 steps, 30-day horizon, features I_k definition.

866cd18f-15.png.summary: Training protocol alignment table: All models use same 2-stage 80-epoch protocol. Fairness verification checklist.

866cd18f-16.png.summary: Main results table with all 7 models. RSE best CVaR95=3.109. RVSN and SAC-CVaR anomalous.

866cd18f-17.png.summary: Statistical comparison: Paired t-tests vs LSTM with Holm-Bonferroni correction. RSE: -3.29%, p<0.0001, d=-7.41.

866cd18f-18.png.summary: Real market validation: SPY crisis results table. W-DRO-T best across all US scenarios.

866cd18f-19.png.summary: NIFTY crisis results. 3SCH best normal (622.26), Transformer best COVID (1644.19), W-DRO-T best 2008 (2349.72).

866cd18f-20.png.summary: Robustness analysis: Crisis-to-normal CVaR ratios. W-DRO-T best COVID robustness (3.92x vs LSTM 4.28x).

866cd18f-21.png.summary: Capital requirements analysis: W-DRO-T achieves 41% savings ($4.79M vs $8.11M per $100M notional).

866cd18f-22.png.summary: Trading volume and cost efficiency table. CVaR-per-trade ratio analysis across models.

866cd18f-23.png.summary: Hedge accounting qualification: All models pass IAS 39/IFRS 9 tests. Dollar offset 0.94-0.97, R²≥0.87.

866cd18f-24.png.summary: Indian market considerations: STT, stamp duty, wider spreads, discrete strikes. 3SCH recommended for NIFTY.

866cd18f-25.png.summary: Model selection guidelines: W-DRO-T for US, 3SCH for India, RSE for regime uncertainty, LSTM for simplicity.

866cd18f-26.png.summary: Limitations and future work: Simulation-to-reality gap, RVSN/SAC-CVaR anomalies, single-asset limitation.

866cd18f-27.png.summary: Conclusion and reproducibility: Code repository structure, commands, seeds, hyperparameters summary.
